item.title: DRUDKH Announce New EP “Thaw” + Share Lead Single ‘Memory’
item.description: Ukrainian atmospheric black metal entity DRUDKH announce their forthcoming EP Thaw with the release of its lead single, “Memory.” Conceived during the same sessions as 2025’s Shadow Play, the new EP stands as a direct continuation of that album’s emotional and thematic landscape. item.title: NECROCCULTUS Announce New Album “The Afterdeath Blackness”, Out April 24th
item.description: Mexican death metal veterans NECROCCULTUS are set to make their triumphant return with their new full-length album “The Afterdeath Blackness”, scheduled for release on April 24th, 2026 via Terror From Hell Records. item.title: INTERNAL DECAY Stream New EP “Fires Of The Forgotten” Ahead of Release
item.description: The fire within Swedish cult death metal band Internal Decay burns again. item.title: EASTBLOOD (Feat. Members of JASTA, DEE SNIDER, GENERATION KILL) Release New Single + Video ‘Grift Witch’
item.description: Eastblood has officially arrived with the release of their debut single “Grift Witch,” accompanied by a new music video. item.title: AEGROR Sign Worldwide Deal with EMG
item.description: Extreme Management Group (EMG), home to bands like Suffocation, Atheist, Cryptopsy and more, has announced their partnership with Atmospheric Black Metal Band AEGROR.
